_comment: Worked example of a customer overlay (fictitious customer, prefix XX; docs/LINK_REGISTRY.md section 7). Validated with the product layers by tools/link_registry.py --check, never seeded. A custom table ZXX_PAY_REQ (payment requests of the customer's feeder), a custom field ZZXX_REQ_ID appended to the standard items table, the flow request -> items -> payment -> bank line, a fallback chain (partner by external number with the feeder, then without), a standard link switched off (no notification-of-change lots) and one replaced (the customer's bank returns the payment reference without leading zeros). Since 2026-11-15 also the customer tables its extensions of the product views join (config/extensions/examples/xx, docs/EXTENDING_WITH_CUSTOMER_DATA.md): requests by number, the audit register of the controls, the service levels of the flow stages, and the link clearing line -> request (inactive until V110). Since 2026-11-16 (build Q) also the intake flow of XX (examples/intake_xx): its intake table ZXX_INTAKE with an identity beyond the request number (feeder logical system, company code, payment reference), its payment reference ZZXX_PAYREF appended to the standard items, the links intake <-> items and clearing line -> intake; the links from the item and the clearing line are ambiguous by design (the item carries no feeder system) and say why.
